glosses: to fall, to die on the battlefield, to be killed in action
to fall, to lose power, to cease to exist, to be toppled

examples.text: Его выбор пал на красную машину.
examples.en: He decided on the red car.

examples.text: В каком году пала Берлинская стена?
examples.en: In what year did the Berlin Wall fall?

examples.text: Лев широко раскрыл пасть и зевнул.
examples.en: The lion opened its jaws wide and yawned.
The deer fell prey to the lion.
